scope: The eight ordinary engine files named as next by M51, with eng_dyn.rs and eng_table.rs excluded as loader/callback boundaries and tb_digest.rs/tb_dsa.rs substituted. Repairs are safety-contract wording for functions whose bodies dereference e unconditionally (M52-D1/D2/D3) plus the M51 follow-up restoring two short EC allocator seam strings to the admitted __FILE__ prefix (M52-D4, metadata only). No production unsafe operation, FFI symbol, allocation extent/line, repr(C) layout, exported signature or unsafe lint attribute changed.

safety_contract_repairs.note: Twenty-two # Safety clauses said e 'must be NULL or point to a live Engine' for ENGINE_unregister_*, ENGINE_register_*, ENGINE_set_default_* and the getter/setter pairs, whose bodies dereference e unconditionally. A permitted input that is UB is not a sound contract; each now requires a non-NULL live Engine. No code changed.

Fifteen clauses of the same class: eng_lib's nine element/getter accessors and eng_pkey's six loader setter/getter functions dereference e without a NULL test. The functions that do test NULL (ENGINE_free, engine_set_all_null, the ex-data pair, ENGINE_load_private_key/public_key/ssl_client_cert) keep the NULL-tolerant wording. No code changed.
ENGINE_set_default, ENGINE_set_default_string and ENGINE_register_complete now require a non-NULL live Engine, matching the arm bodies they dispatch to. No code changed.

The M51 follow-up: FILE is now ../../src/openssl-3.6.4/crypto/ec/ecdh_ossl.c at :61 and ../../src/openssl-3.6.4/crypto/ec/ecdsa_ossl.c at :66, restoring the admitted build record's __FILE__ for the CRYPTO_malloc/CRYPTO_clear_free and OPENSSL_free coordinates. M49 ownership evidence is unaffected.

file_dispositions.note: crypto/engine/eng_all.c: the transcription is the authority's own OPENSSL_init_crypto call; the still-unsupported ENGINE_* init bit remains the recorded divergence, so no engine is registered in this crate.
crypto/engine/eng_fat.c. M52-D3 contract repair. The all-tables unregistration on ENGINE_remove remains the recorded deliberate improvement over the authority's dangling borrowed table entry.

crypto/engine/eng_lib.c. M52-D2 contract repair. RawEngine releases only the block on ENGINE_new's CRYPTO_new_ex_data refusal; OwnedEngine runs the authority's pkey-method free, destroy hook, dynamic unlink, ex-data free and single block release in the authority's order. engine_set_all_null matches eng_lib.c:56-75 exactly, including its deliberate non-clearing of ec_meth/pkey_meths/pkey_asn1_meths/load_ssl_client_cert.
crypto/engine/eng_pkey.c (3.5.0 shape): NULL, funct_ref, then no-loader refusal order; the entry points forward the caller's loader and arguments verbatim. M52-D2 contract repair.
crypto/engine/tb_cipher.c. M52-D1 contract repair. The callback is the observable; no in-crate caller selects through this table.
crypto/engine/tb_dh.c. M52-D1 contract repair. DH_METHOD remains opaque in this unit.
crypto/engine/tb_digest.c. Substitute for the boundary file eng_table.rs; M52-D1 contract repair.
crypto/engine/tb_dsa.c. Substitute for the boundary file eng_dyn.rs; M52-D1 contract repair.

retained_observations: The same NULL-permissive # Safety wording remains in the still-unaudited tb_eckey.rs, tb_pkmeth.rs, tb_rand.rs and tb_rsa.rs siblings; it should be repaired when those files are audited.
The M49 ownership evidence for ecdh_ossl/ecdsa_ossl is unaffected by the seam metadata repair; only the reported allocator coordinate changes, and it now matches the admitted build record.
engine_set_all_null intentionally leaves ec_meth, pkey_meths, pkey_asn1_meths and load_ssl_client_cert uncleared, exactly as eng_lib.c:56-75 does; this is not an omission.

ENGINE_set_ex_data/ENGINE_get_ex_data answer 0/NULL for a NULL engine where the authority dereferences it (C UB). This existing in-crate safety improvement is recorded here rather than silently inherited.
The batch contains no secret copy and no constant-time claim; engine method tables are public data and no cryptographic algorithm was changed.
